headline: Slaughter and May, Eversheds Sutherland, Khaitan & Co act on Brahma AI $150 million fundraise
sum: Brahma AI has raised $150 million through the issuance of preferred shares, with a $100 million investment by Multiples Alternate Asset Management. Slaughter and May advised Brahma AI on this transaction.
detail: Brahma AI has raised $150 million through the issuance of preferred shares, with a $100 million investment by Multiples Alternate Asset Management. Slaughter and May advised Brahma AI on this transaction. The transaction was led by David Griffith-Jones (Partner, Corporate), Harry Hecht (Partner, Corporate), Gareth Miles (Partner, Tax), Duncan Blaikie (Partner, Technology) and Jonathan Slade (Partner, Competition). From Brahma AI, Adam Eastell (Chief Strategy Officer) and Michael Ogden (General Counsel) were involved in the transaction.
